description: fiboa is a specification for publishing agricultural field boundaries in a shared format. Its README describes a core schema with extensions and identifies global interoperability of open field geometry as its purpose. Users encode parcels and selected properties according to version 0.3.0; outputs are compatible field-boundary records that can be joined to remote sensing or farm data. Geographic coverage is global in design, though actual coverage depends on publishers. GitHub metadata states Apache-2.0 licensing. A limitation is that the README calls the standard work in progress, and a conforming boundary may still be old, disputed or too coarse for irrigation design. The schema can improve land-parcel inputs for crop, water-demand and agricultural supply-chain simulations. The related QGIS catalogue platform can process field geometries but does not define fiboa. No field dataset or package was downloaded.
name: fiboa agricultural field-boundary schema
